description.narrative: The program will support the Government of Cambodia in diversifying Cambodia's economy and boosting its international competitiveness. It underpins the government's efforts to achieve a higher income status and to improve the livelihoods of its citizens through sustainable economic growth. The program will support three reform areas aimed at: (i) enhancing the enabling environment for investment and business; (ii) growing micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs); and (iii) improving trade policy and trade facilitation.

Action 1: 2.1 The government implemented the Investment Law by issuing a sub-decree that (i) specifies investment application processes and requirements for enterprises, (ii) standardizes government's aftercare services to investors, and (iii) provides tax incentives for investment in research and development activities, providing skills and vocational training to Cambodian employees, and promoting the welfare of Cambodian workers, including through the provision of nurseries at the workplace (MEF and Council for the Development of Cambodia) Target value: 55
Action 2: 2.2 The government fully onboarded 10 more ministries or agencies to the OBR to expand the scope of online issuance of specialized business licenses, permits, and certificates. (MEF) Target value: 55
Action 3: 2.3 The government (i) established and operationalized a National Authority for Alternative Dispute Resolution to expedite the out-of-court resolution of disputes through conciliation;g and (ii) implemented a tailored capacity building program on commercial law and commercial cases for judges and judicial staff. (MOJ) Target value: 55
Action 4: 2.4 The government: (i) issued a sub-decree on the guiding principles for laws and regulations to improve the quality of new legislation, making it compulsory for line ministries to submit RIA reports alongside all draft laws and regulations relating to economic, finance, social, and environmental sectors submitted to the OCM; and (ii) established a RIA oversight and coordination function within the OCM to oversee RIA reform and support the adoption of RIA among line ministries in Cambodia. (OCM) Target value: 55
Action 5: 2.5 The government: (i) issued a sub-decree to establish the National Laboratory for Science, Technology and Innovation to undertake product testing, and to facilitate greater collaboration between public and private sectors in research and innovation; and (ii) adopted and commenced implementation of a Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion action plan for the industry, science, and innovation sectors. (MISTI) Target value: 55

Policy 2: Growing Micro, Small, and Medium-Sized Businesses NA
Action 2: 2.7 The government, through Khmer Enterprise, (i) established the National Advisory Board for Impact Investment to further develop the impact investing ecosystem and to promote and mobilize impact investment capital; (ii) completed implementation of the PRISME programn to provide targeted capacity support to impact MSMEs to mobilize venture capital to solve social and economic challenges; (iii) implemented, in conjunction with CWEA, a Women Entrepreneur Award program, which aims to strengthen women entrepreneurs' capacity to access business loans, and promote their products and service;o and (iv) supported women-owned MSMEs through mentorships and grant finance under the CNAI program. (MISTI) Target value: 10
Action 3: 2.8 The government established and operationalized an online digital support hub for MSMEs to provide training and business support services relating to the digital transformation of their businesses. (MEF) Target value: 10
Action 4: 2.9 The government issued regulations to enhance lending using movable collateral by clearly defining acceptable collateral, encouraging online public record searches to reduce risks and disputes, and allowing creditors to report default debtors with the Ministry of Commerce. (MOC, MEF) Target value: 10
Action 5: 2.10 The government: (i) adopted a FinTech development policy, to enhance the use of technology to deliver financial services and products; and (ii) established a FinTech center at the NBFSA to promote and support digital transformation in the financial sector, to collect and manage data on FinTech, and to develop technology risk management frameworks, and (iii) through NBFSA, the Insurance Regulator, the Securities and Exchange Regulator of Cambodia and the Trust Regulator established regulatory sandboxes for FinTech in their respective sectors. (MEF) Target value: 10
